Two-pointer merge for two; min-heap for k. O(n log k).

For merge two sorted lists I will pick the smallest head from each list.

```python
import heapq
def merge_k(lists):
    pq = [(l.val, i, l) for i, l in enumerate(lists) if l]
    heapq.heapify(pq)
    dummy = cur = ListNode(0)
    while pq:
        _, i, n = heapq.heappop(pq)
        cur.next = n
        cur = cur.next
        if n.next: heapq.heappush(pq, (n.next.val, i, n.next))
    return dummy.next
```
